g.text: The other tiers (sm75/sm80/sm120) keep the CUDA 13.0 ptxas; their PTX and cubins stay byte-identical. A lint rejects sm_75+ opcodes (ldmatrix, m16n8k8, cp.async) in sm70 PTX.
